releaseTitle: ATalk v3.17.0 — Keyboard GIF Insertion & Google Maps Location Sharing Hub
releaseNotes:
• 01 Keyboard GIF Insertion (Gboard, Samsung, SwiftKey): Fully wired Compose rich content receiving (`Modifier.contentReceiver` with `TextFieldState`) to enable direct insertion of animated GIFs and stickers from software keyboards.
• 02 Global Animated GIF Decoding (Coil): Implemented `ImageLoaderFactory` in `ChessApp` registering `ImageDecoderDecoder` and `GifDecoder` for smooth 60fps looping of animated keyboard GIFs.
• 03 Uncompressed GIF Stream Delivery: Bypassed lossy JPEG compression in the media pipeline for GIFs, preserving original animation frames and uploading them as pristine `.gif` files.
• 04 Google Maps Location Sharing Hub: Replaced manual coordinate typing with an interactive location sharing hub featuring automatic device GPS acquisition, live accuracy telemetry (±8m), and reverse geocoding to human street addresses.
• 05 Landmark & Address Search: Added live forward geocoding allowing users to search any landmark, city, or address on Google Maps and place a pin.
• 06 Visual Map Message Cards: Replaced plain location text with interactive visual map canvas cards featuring glowing location pins, 'Google Maps' direct viewer, and turn-by-turn 'Navigate' driving directions.
